title: 第980章 轮番上阵第979章 甜头
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
“尽管放手去游玩，只是务必谨记分寸，切莫一时失手将人直接了结。”
“这些耗费时日方才成长起来的上好韭菜，唯有循序渐进慢慢收割，方才有意思。”
“多谢公子！”
众女闻言齐齐面露喜色，欢声四起。
转瞬便兴致勃勃围拢在一起，热烈商讨各自想要扮演的身份人设，又迫不及待动身，前去挑选适配身份的衣衫、各式掩人耳目的道具。
一个时辰后。
天渊神境，【迷失石林】深处。
成片嶙峋高耸的石柱交错林立，构筑出层层叠叠、无穷无尽的迷宫通道。
灰白石体间萦绕着浓稠灰白的迷阵雾霭，不断扭曲方位，干扰修士神识。
几名出身南荒顶尖大教的天骄满身尘土，衣袍多处被石棱划破。
脸上沾着污泥与疲惫，正麻木地在往复循环的石柱迷阵之中不停打转。
他们被困在此地足足三天三夜，随身携带的疗伤丹药早已消耗一空，神识持续被阵法消磨。
周遭连一头妖兽、一丝灵迹都寻觅不到，长久的绝望不断侵蚀心神，众人的心态已然濒临彻底崩溃的边缘。
“难道我们真的要死在这破石头阵里了吗……”
一名天骄双腿发软，浑身力气仿佛被尽数抽空，双膝一沉。
绝望地重重跪倒在布满碎石的地面，声音沙哑干涩，满是无力。
就在这片死寂弥漫之际。
“天地不仁，以万物为刍狗，阵道无极，以星辰为棋子。”
一道空灵淡漠、不带半分人间烟火气息的浩渺女声，悠悠自厚重迷雾深处缓缓飘荡而出。
声音似跨越万古时空，悠远苍茫，在石林之间不断回荡震颤。

几名天骄身躯齐齐猛地一震，眼底闪过惊悸与希冀，下意识猛地抬头，慌张望向声音传来的方向。
只见前方翻涌不散的迷雾正缓缓向两侧分开，如同帷幕徐徐拉开。
一座布满古老刻痕、饱经岁月侵蚀的青石祭坛静静显现，祭坛石台之上，不知何时多出一道窈窕身影。
女子身披一袭素雅月白斗篷，兜帽轻垂，面容被一层镌刻着玄妙阵纹的薄纱遮掩，平添无尽神秘感，正是一位风华绝世的仙子。
她静静端坐，眼帘轻抬，一双深邃眼眸之中，两轮金色星盘正缓慢循环流转。
仅仅只是遥遥对视一眼，众人便好似坠入无边浩瀚星海，神魂微微震颤，心底生出难以言喻的敬畏！
“前……前辈？！”
几名天骄仿佛抓住绝境之中唯一的救命稻草，眼中瞬间燃起光亮。
踉跄着扑上前，齐齐俯身，恭恭敬敬跪伏在祭坛之下，大气不敢喘上一口。
“念尔等向道之心尚坚，本座便赐尔等一场造化。”
化身上古阵道大能残魂的柳凝光稳住心神，竭力压抑心底快要溢出来的笑意，维持着高深莫测、淡漠悠远的语调缓缓开口。
话音落下，她广袖轻轻一扬，一卷薄薄的绢册自袖中凌空飞出，缓缓飘落至众人身前。
这卷口诀粗浅寻常，就算是神木宗外门普通弟子，都瞧不上眼，根本不屑修习。
“参悟此诀，可保尔等走出这石林。若尔等能在三日内，为本座寻来一百块‘紫金陨铁’献于此祭坛，本座……便传尔等无上仙阵！”
几名天骄双手颤抖，如获至宝一般小心翼翼捧住那卷略显陈旧简陋的玉简，心头狂喜翻涌。
content_en:
"You can go and have fun, but you must remember to be cautious and never kill someone by mistake."
"These fine leeks that take a long time to grow can only be interesting if they are harvested step by step and slowly."
"Thank you, sir!"
When all the girls heard this, they all looked happy and cheered.
In an instant, they gathered together in great interest, discussing enthusiastically the identities they wanted to play, and couldn't wait to set off to pick out clothes that fit their identities and all kinds of hidden props.
An hour later.
Tianyuan Divine Realm, deep in the [Lost Stone Forest].
A patchwork of rugged and towering stone pillars stand interlaced, creating an endless labyrinth of passages.
A thick gray-white mist lingers between the gray-white stone bodies, constantly distorting the direction and interfering with the monks' spiritual consciousness.
Several prodigies who came from the top sects in the Southern Wilderness were covered in dust, and their robes were torn in many places by stone edges.
His face was stained with mud and exhaustion, and he was numbly spinning around in the maze of stone pillars that circulated back and forth.
They were trapped here for three days and three nights. The healing pills they carried with them had long been consumed, and their consciousness continued to be consumed by the formation.
There was not even a single monster or trace of a spirit to be found around them. The long-term despair continued to corrode their minds, and everyone's mentality was already on the verge of complete collapse.
"Are we really going to die in this broken stone formation..."
A genius' legs felt weak, and all the strength in his body seemed to be drained, and his knees sank.
Desperately, he knelt heavily on the gravel-covered ground, his voice hoarse and dry, full of weakness.
Just as this deathly silence spread.
"Heaven and earth are unkind, treating all things as stupid dogs, forming infinite formations, and using stars as chess pieces."
A vast female voice that was ethereal and indifferent, without even a trace of human fireworks, floated slowly out from the depths of the thick fog.
The sound seemed to span eternity and time, and was far and wide, constantly reverberating and trembling among the stone forests.
The bodies of several geniuses all trembled, panic and hope flashed in their eyes. They subconsciously raised their heads and looked in the direction of the sound in panic.
I saw that the surging fog ahead was slowly parting to both sides, like a curtain slowly opening.
A bluestone altar covered with ancient carvings and eroded by time appeared quietly. On the stone platform of the altar, a graceful figure appeared out of nowhere.
The woman is wearing a simple and elegant moon-white cloak, with a hood that hangs lightly, and her face is covered by a layer of gauze engraved with mysterious patterns, adding an endless sense of mystery. She is a fairy with unparalleled splendor.
She sat quietly, her eyes slightly raised, and in a pair of deep eyes, two golden astrolabees were slowly circulating.
Just looking at each other from a distance, everyone seemed to have fallen into the boundless sea of ​​stars, their souls trembled slightly, and there was indescribable awe in their hearts!
"Senior...senior?!"
The few geniuses seemed to grasp the only life-saving straw in a desperate situation, and their eyes instantly lit up.
Staggering forward, they all leaned down and knelt respectfully under the altar, not daring to take a breath.
"Since your heart towards the Tao is still strong, I will give you a blessing."
Liu Ningguang, who had transformed into the powerful remnant soul of the Ancient Formation Dao, stabilized his mind, tried his best to suppress the smile that was about to overflow from his heart, and spoke slowly while maintaining an inscrutable, indifferent and distant tone.
After the words fell, she gently raised her sleeves, and a thin roll of silk flew out of her sleeves and slowly fell in front of everyone.
This volume of formulas is so simple and ordinary that even the ordinary disciples of the outer sect of the Shenmu Sect look down upon it and do not even bother to practice it.
"After understanding this technique, Paul and others can walk out of this stone forest. If you and others can find one hundred pieces of 'Purple Gold Meteor Iron' for me to offer to this altar within three days, I... will pass on the supreme immortal formation to you and others!"
The hands of several geniuses were trembling, and they carefully held the slightly old and crude jade slip as if they had found a treasure, their hearts filled with ecstasy.
